description: Sends a correction for a wrong or missing value (Hán Việt, Vietnamese meaning, English, pinyin, a missing word) as a public GitHub issue in OpenCidian/opencidian-data; a maintainer reviews it, nothing changes in the data until then. Returns the issue number and link. Only use it when the user asks to report a mistake or agrees to, with evidence from a dictionary or textbook, never for a guess. The issue is public: put no personal details in it. A few per minute for all callers together.

current.description: The value OpenCidian gives now, copied from a lookup.

evidence.description: Where the right value comes from: a dictionary (Thiều Chửu, hvdic.thivien.net, a textbook) with a page or link. Not your own guess.

field.description: What is wrong: hanviet (Hán Việt reading), vi (Vietnamese meaning), en (English), pinyin, missing (a word the dictionary lacks), other.

pinyin.description: The pinyin, only when the fix is for one reading of the word (觉 jiào, not jué).

word.description: The word or character the fix is for, in hanzi (说, 觉得).

name: suggest_correction
title: Suggest a correction
